name: kora-v2
description: Kora Framework development skill for building production-grade Java/Kotlin services — with compile-time DI, HTTP, Database, Kafka, gRPC, SOAP, OpenAPI, Telemetry, AOP. Zero reflection, zero proxies, synchronous contracts on virtual threads, AI agent friendly. For Kora version 2.x
author: Anton Kurako

requirements.java: 25+ (Kora 2.0 artifacts are compiled to class-file 69; the JDK running Gradle must also be 25+ when io.koraframework:openapi-generator is on the buildscript classpath)
requirements.kotlin: 2.4.10 with KSP 2.3.11 (must match the versions the framework itself is built with)

documentation.kora_docs_note: https://kora-projects.github.io/kora-docs/en/ documents Kora 1.x only — there is no 2.0 documentation site yet, so it must not be used as an API authority for 2.x
